maddeler.e:
يمتهن (form VIII)
# يَمْتَهِنُ (yamtahinu) /jam.ta.hi.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِمْتَهَنَ (imtahana)
# يَمْتَهِنَّ (yamtahinna) /jam.ta.hin.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَهَنَ (imtahana)
# يُمْتَهَنُ (yumtahanu) /jum.ta.ha.nu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَهَ
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
